about: Code-switching (Arabic + English medical words) and Arabizi (Arabic in Latin letters with digits) as Saudi users type. Written by the project author while building V285, so this is a DEVELOPMENT set, not a held-out estimate: the honest held-out test is the externally written set described in EXTERNAL_HELDOUT_PROTOCOL.md. Region tags describe the vocabulary used (najdi, hejazi, gulf/eastern, southern) and are approximate. Labels are the author's starter labels (high = emergency now, medium = medical assessment within 24-48 h, low = self-care) and are NOT clinician-verified until doctor_labels.csv is completed.
